# Kissan Sahyog (किसान सहयोग)

> Kissan Sahyog (kissansahyog.com) is a farm marketplace and information website for Sagar Division (Sagar Sambhag), Madhya Pradesh, where farmers, labourers, machine owners and local suppliers meet in one place.
> किसान सहयोग (kissansahyog.com) सागर संभाग, मध्य प्रदेश के लिए खेती का बाज़ार और सूचना वेबसाइट है, जहाँ किसान, मज़दूर, मशीन मालिक और स्थानीय आपूर्तिकर्ता एक ही जगह मिलते हैं।
> It is owned and run by Shri Abhinandan Dixit. The site is bilingual (Hindi-first). We list farm equipment, land, labour,
> inputs, transport, cold storage, greenhouses and rural innovations; publish
> cited knowledge (schemes, crop problems, weather, mandi/MSP prices); and never
> handle payments. Every published fact is sourced and cited. English brand name:
> Kissan Sahyog. Contact: hello@kissansahyog.com. Complaints: grievance@kissansahyog.com.

## Marketplace (public browse; login only to see a seller's number or to post)
- Equipment, land, labour, agri-inputs, bhusa/parali, transport, water tanker
- Warehouse & cold storage, greenhouse/polyhouse, jugaad (rural innovations)

## Knowledge hubs (public, prerendered, cited)
- /greenhouse — greenhouse & polyhouse: MP subsidy cost-norms, MPFSTS, calculators, vendor-safety
- /carbon-credit — carbon credit for farmers: facts, Indian examples, policy options (/carbon-credit/niti-sujhav printable brief)
- /jugaad — rural innovations: support schemes (NIF, NIDHI-PRAYAS, Startup India), legal & safety
- /cold-storage — MP Cold Storage Finder (public directory + district pages /cold-storage/<district>)

## Kisan Sawaal — farmer Q&A knowledge base (Hindi, cited)
- /sawaal — index (search + filters)
- /sawaal/<slug> — individual answers (symptoms, causes, cultural→biological→chemical control, prevention)
- /fasal/<crop>/samasya — crop problem hubs (soybean, wheat, maize, gram, lentil, urad, moong, tomato, onion, garlic, chilli)
- /sawaal/vishay/<category> — category hubs (pest, disease, nutrient, weed, variety, sowing, irrigation, harvest, soil, scheme, mandi, storage)

## Prices, weather, schemes
- /mausam — weather (IMD-based advisories)
- /msp and /msp/<crop> — MSP + Sagar Division mandi prices
- /yojana, /yojana/<slug> — government schemes
- /kisan-mela — agri fairs & events

## Reference
- /guide — short tap-through demos: /guide/register, /guide/post, /guide/find (getting a seller's number), /guide/tour
- /articles, /safalta (success stories), /videos, /drone-didi, /resources (KVK & agri contacts)
- /grievance, /terms, /privacy, /contact
- Sources register: every number is cited to an official/news/company/judgment source.
